Long-BLOB hash correctness is covered directly: same-length no-op BLOB updates suppress emission, while changes after the first 8-byte chunk emit

claims.text: The 8-byte FNV fold scales acceptably to mixed 32KB TEXT+BLOB long payloads (3.446 ms median beside 2.356 ms for 4KB TEXT), and the streaming suite now covers that shape.
